Loss report: drone -> gitea
[emulated] pipeline/drone job.if: !github.event.deleted on every job (GitHub Actions runs a push workflow when a branch is deleted and the source starts no run for that; each job condition ends with the guard)
[emulated] pipeline/drone/job/ci job.cache: actions/cache step with a rolling key (the key is <key>-run-<run_id>-<run_attempt> and the restore prefix is <key>-run-: each run saves a new cache and restores the newest by prefix, because actions/cache never overwrites a key; two jobs of one run that share a key race on the same key and the first to save wins, where on GitLab the last upload wins; the new entries grow toward the 10 GB repository cache limit and evict the least recently used caches, including caches of other keys; GitHub restores only caches of the current branch, the base branch of a pull request and the default branch, while a GitLab key with no branch part is shared across branches)
[emulated] pipeline/drone/job/ci job.runner: default runner label ubuntu-latest (the IR holds no runner label)
[emulated] pipeline/drone/job/ci step.action: actions/checkout step (Drone clones the repository before the steps (https://docs.drone.io/pipeline/docker/syntax/cloning/); clone.depth maps to the step input, and GHA does not clone)
[emulated] pipeline/drone/job/ci/step/build step.image: uses: docker://<image> with entrypoint and args
[emulated] pipeline/drone/trigger/0 trigger.push: branches: '**' (GHA fires a push without filters for branches and tags; branches are named explicitly to leave tags out or beside a tag filter)
[native] pipeline/drone/job/ci/synth/cache step.action (resolves against DEFAULT_ACTIONS_URL; default github)
[native] pipeline/drone/job/ci/synth/checkout step.action (resolves against DEFAULT_ACTIONS_URL; default github)
